nodes.content: Design a GPU-sharing runtime that bounds inference latency while reclaiming memory from concurrent, stateful training jobs.
requirements: Under admitted mixed workloads, inference p99 latency stays within 1.2× its isolated baseline.
Training maintains forward progress through memory reclamation without restarting or corrupting optimizer state.

nodes.content: Combine latency-profiled admission, bounded training kernel slices, inference-priority dispatch, and versioned optimizer-state offload with asynchronous prefetch at step boundaries.
What kernel-slice duration and optimizer-state offload bandwidth keep inference p99 ≤1.2× baseline without stalling training?
At ≤1 ms kernel slices and ≥12 GB/s offload, inference p99 stays ≤1.2× baseline; training advances with intact optimizer state.
Run H100 MixBench, sweeping 0.5–2 ms slices and 8–16 GB/s offload; measure p99 versus baseline, training steps, optimizer checksums.
H100 MixBench: 1 ms slices and 12 GB/s offload yielded 1.16× isolated inference p99; 2,400 steps, reference-matching optimizer checksums.
Adopt 1 ms slices and 12 GB/s offload reservation for admitted MixBench-class workloads; measured latency and optimizer integrity meet requirements.
Implement profile-based admission, 1 ms slices, 12 GB/s versioned optimizer offload/prefetch, and p99, training-progress, checksum release gates.
Implement ShareRun v0.1 versioned optimizer-state eviction and prefetch at step boundaries, reserving 12 GB/s and verifying restored tensor checksums.
ShareRun v0.1 optimizer-state manager adds versioned eviction, step-boundary prefetch, 12 GB/s reservation, and restored-tensor checksum verification.
Run H100 MixBench using ShareRun v0.1 with forced 6 GB evictions; measure inference p99, training continuity, and optimizer checksums.
With forced 6 GB evictions, ShareRun v0.1 delivered 1.18× isolated p99, 1,800 uninterrupted training steps, and reference-matching optimizer checksums.
Integrate ShareRun v0.1's state manager: 6 GB evictions held p99 at 1.18× baseline without interrupting or corrupting training.
With 0.5 ms slices and compute-overlapped prefetch, 8 GB/s offload keeps inference p99 ≤1.2× baseline while training advances.
Run H100 MixBench with 0.5 ms slices, 8 GB/s overlapped prefetch, and 6 GB evictions; record p99, steps, checksums.
H100 MixBench: 0.5 ms slices and 8 GB/s prefetch yielded 1.27× inference p99; 1,800 steps, matching optimizer checksums.
Trace H100 MixBench at 0.5 ms slices and 8 GB/s, attributing p99 violations to dispatch gaps versus prefetch contention.
Priority-dispatched H100 MixBench windows at 0.5 ms slices and 8 GB/s overlapped prefetch showed 1.17× p99 and uninterrupted training.
Use inference-reserved CUDA MPS quotas and pinned-host optimizer tiering, adapting training admission to queue depth with step-atomic state swaps.
What inference MPS quota and queue-depth trigger preserve p99 during 6 GB optimizer eviction without starving training?
A 70% inference MPS quota and four-request training-kernel deferral yield ≤1.2× p99 and checksum-correct progress during 6 GB evictions.
Run H100 MixBench with 70% inference MPS quota, four-request deferral, and 6 GB evictions; measure p99, steps, checksums.
H100 MixBench: 70% inference MPS quota and four-request deferral yielded 1.15× p99, 1,500 uninterrupted steps, matching optimizer checksums.
Implement 70% inference MPS quota and four-request training deferral; gate admission on p99 ≤1.2× baseline and checksum-correct progress.
Implement ShareRun v0.2 MPS admission controller with 70% inference quota, four-request training deferral, and step-atomic pinned-host optimizer swaps.
ShareRun v0.2 adds a 70% inference MPS quota, four-request training deferral, and step-atomic pinned-host optimizer-state swaps.
Stress-test ShareRun v0.2 on H100 MixBench burst traces with 6 GB evictions; compare isolated p99, completed steps, optimizer checksums.
ShareRun v0.2 H100 MixBench bursts with 6 GB evictions: p99 was 1.17× isolated; 1,420 uninterrupted steps, matching optimizer checksums.
Run ShareRun v0.2's 30-minute H100 MixBench saturation test; measure training-step gaps, inference p99, and optimizer checksums.
In 30-minute admitted MixBench saturation, p99 was 1.16× baseline; four-request deferral blocked all training steps after 6 GB eviction.
Retain MPS quota and atomic swaps, but block v0.2 release until bounded training service replaces starvation-prone deferral.
Retain 70% MPS quota; replace indefinite deferral with guaranteed 0.5-ms training slices every 20 ms, admission-gated at 1.2× baseline p99.
Patch ShareRun v0.2 scheduler to grant one 0.5-ms training slice per 20 ms despite queued inference requests.
ShareRun v0.3 replaces v0.2's four-request deferral with guaranteed 0.5-ms training service every 20 ms, retaining quota and swaps.
Rerun 30-minute H100 MixBench saturation with ShareRun v0.3 and 6 GB evictions; record p99, training-step gaps, optimizer checksums.
30-minute ShareRun v0.3 saturation: 6 GB evictions yielded 1.24× inference p99 despite 930 checksum-correct training steps.
Retain MPS sharing for burst-limited trials, but withhold production release: v0.2 starves training under saturation; v0.3 breaches p99.
Admit inference bursts only when profiled slack accommodates guaranteed training slots and transactional optimizer offload, preserving latency and progress.
What admission slack permits 0.5-ms training slots every 20 ms and 6 GB evictions while keeping inference p99 ≤1.2× baseline?
With ≥15% profiled slack per 20-ms window, 0.5-ms training slots preserve ≤1.2× p99 and checksum-correct progress through 6 GB evictions.
Sweep H100 MixBench admission slack around 15% with 0.5-ms/20-ms training slots and 6-GB evictions; measure p99, steps, checksums.
H100 MixBench at 15% admitted slack: 1.18× isolated p99, 1,060 uninterrupted steps through 6-GB evictions, reference-matching checksums.
Adopt ≥15% profiled admission slack with guaranteed training slots for MixBench-class workloads; tested p99 and optimizer checksums pass.
Partition H100 into fixed inference and training MIG instances; reclaim training optimizer memory through step-atomic CPU paging without repartitioning.
Which H100 MIG partition sizes leave enough inference capacity and training memory for checksum-correct 6 GB optimizer paging?
A 4g.40gb inference/3g.40gb training split keeps admitted MixBench p99 ≤1.2× isolated while preserving checksum-correct progress through 6 GB paging.
Configure H100 4g.40gb/3g.40gb MIG instances; run MixBench with 6 GB step-atomic paging, logging p99, training steps, and checksums.
MIG MixBench: 4g.40gb inference reached 1.46× full-H100 isolated p99; 6 GB paging completed 840 checksum-correct training steps.
Restrict 4g.40gb/3g.40gb to models with ≤1.1× full-H100 isolated p99 on 4g; predict ≤1.2× mixed p99 and checksum-correct paging.
Filter MixBench models by ≤1.1× 4g/full-H100 p99; run qualifying 4g/3g MIG workloads with 6 GB paging; record p99, steps, checksums.
Qualifying MIG MixBench models reached 1.16× full-H100 isolated p99; 6 GB paging completed 820 uninterrupted, checksum-correct training steps.
Restrict 4g/3g MIG to models with 4g isolated p99 ≤1.1× full-H100 isolated p99; qualifying mixed p99 was 1.16×.
